name: Preterm Labour, PROM and Post-Term: Steroids, Magnesium and Induction

reference.source: Sakshi Arora Obstetrics E9 + Gynecology by Ten Teachers 21st Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Infected membranes prostaglandinise ripening cervix while steroids surfactantise fetal lungs and magnesium stabilises cerebral vessels; prolonged rupture ascends infecting decidua spiking maternal fetal tachycardias, and postmature placenta calcifies failing.
